config_entries.label: Blank On Start
config_entries.description: Whether or not to blank all LEDs when effect starts. Deaults to `True`.

config_entries.label: Port
config_entries.description: The port to run the UDP server on. Defaults to `21324`.

config_entries.label: Sync Group Mask
config_entries.description: Used with WLED Notifier. The Sync Group mask value that specifies which WLED Sync Groups to listen to. Defaults to `0` (All Sync Groups). Sync Groups 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8 use masks 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128. Combine mask values to listen to multiple Sync Groups.
